findings.location: test-host-check.sh docker-unreachable case (blind fixture, grep -Eiq docker)
findings.obligation: B7 refusal: when Docker cannot be asked, say so and do not call host clean (P5)
findings.observation: Non-blocking. The case passes on any output containing the word docker, e.g. a finding HOW text such as docker rmi, so a check that swallows the failure but still prints a docker remedy line and exits 1 would pass; the stand-in docker_down also leaves the clean path untested.
findings.remediation: Optionally require a line matching (cannot|could not|unable|not reach|failed).*docker or docker.*(cannot|could not|unreachable|not running) in the blind output.

findings.location: test-host-check.sh stand-in systemctl is-active/is-enabled; runner fixture
findings.obligation: Leftover host runner service found (P5), without coupling to one implementation
findings.observation: Non-blocking. is-active/is-enabled match exact unit names only (real is-active accepts globs); the runner leftover fixture is always enabled and active, so an installed but disabled or stopped host runner unit is untested.
findings.remediation: Optionally let is-active glob like list-units, and add a runner variant that is disabled or inactive if the design counts it a leftover.

observations.text: argv: bash tools/codesign/tests/test-host-check.sh (run at HEAD bf0aed0ee, oracle unchanged since). Result: observed=18 assertions_failed=1 setup_failed=0; sole FAIL is "a retired host where systemd answers the old runner query with no match and exit status 1 ... says host is clean and exits 0"; WHAT shows output "UNKNOWN: systemd could not be asked for an old host actions runner service ()." exit 1. Matches root-reported RED (reused, reproduced). Semantic RED: check-host.sh line 27 treats exit 1 with empty listing as unreachable; not an infra error.

Judged by git show HEAD diff: stand-in changes are flag-gated (state/systemd_down, state/systemctl_no_match_fails); other fixtures never create those files so existing cases are unchanged (all 16 prior cases PASS). No-match stand-in emits nothing and exits 1 only when zero units match; systemd_down emits a stderr error and exits 1 for every systemctl call. check-host.sh merges stderr (2>&1), so the two cases are discriminable only by stderr content: wrong fix "any exit 1 = no match" fails the systemd-unreachable case (requires could-not wording, no clean line, exit 1); wrong fix "never-clean" fails the no-match case. Residual: a fix parsing stderr as unit names would likely still be caught by the unreachable-wording requirement, but the down case does not assert absence of a bogus finding line (advisory, non-blocking). Skill test-writing last line quoted: "End of SKILL.md". Jev: unauthorized, typesafe: unavailable by config.

diagnostic: Two added cases approved: constructible via public check-host.sh with stand-ins, semantic RED observed (1 failing, correct reason), contrast case separates no-match from systemd-unreachable; prior approval stands for other cases.
